verdict.rationale: Airweave supports automatic background syncing of source connections (docs-2) and webhook notifications when syncs/collections change (docs-9), which are forms of autonomous background operation, but there's no evidence of a broader automation/workflow builder (e.g., scheduled tasks, multi-step triggers/actions) that a user could configure to run autonomously beyond data sync. Missing for 10: evidence of configurable trigger-action automations, scheduling UI, or autonomous agent tasks beyond syncing/search.
